verdict.rationale: Gmail ships an in-product AI assistant (Gemini) that can take actions such as organizing email, so whether it can connect to external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence mentions MCP or any way to register external tool servers. Workspace add-ons and the Gmail API are separate extension mechanisms and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
